title: Play a note
intro: Sound is air wiggling. How many wiggles per second decides the pitch. `note(440)` plays 440 wiggles per second, which is the note A.
You can also use note names: `note('C4')`. The number after the letter is the octave. A higher number sounds higher.
task: Run it. Then change the notes and the timing to make your own three-note pattern. The second number in `note` is when it starts, in seconds.
hint: Try 'D4' or 'F4' instead of 'E4'. Sharps use #, like 'F#4'.
